conflicts: Capstan nut trap: the stage-0 coupon C08a (make_stage0.c08) cuts a square-ended side slot that stops at axis-2.8; an M3 nut (e/2 = 3.175) then sits 0.375 off the screw axis. The spec here uses a hex-ended pocket centred on the axis (closed-side wall 0.77). The model's mass-model void is a centred 5.6 x 5.6 x 2.6 box (not side-open).

Lever carriers C#, E, G, A#, A#0 have hub collars on BOTH sides (P14 / end_parts collars), so neither side face can lie flat on the bed as DESIGN 15 prescribes ('옆벽이 베드'). Proposal in print_orientation.lever_carriers (merge collar pairs onto the +x side) - needs the owner's OK because it changes P14.

The 'carrier core (steel bottom)' prism in geometry.json is solid through the steel volume; the production export (C16a) cuts the 40 x 19 cavity. Anyone building the carrier straight from the prisms must apply that cut (feature listed).
Balance-pin groove y134.0-138.0 ends 0.237 inside the front lip wall (lip region starts y137.763): the groove above z22.3 cuts into that wall's upper part; harmless, noted for the CAD boolean.
coords: all key features in the key frame at rest (design pose) and all carrier features in the lever frame at b = 0 (geometry side_rigid0), module x unless noted; world x = 47 + 164.5*(k-1) + x for module Ok, left end part x = world x, right end part world x = 1198.5 + local x
